name: Jinduicheng Molybdenum Co., Ltd.
summary: Jinduicheng Molybdenum Co., Ltd. provides molybdenum in China and internationally. It operates through Molybdenum Ore Products and Metal Trading Products segments. The company offers molybdenum furnace charge products comprising molybdenum concentrate, roasted molybdenum concentrate (powder and lumps), and ferromolybdenum; molybdenum chemical products, such as ammonium molybdate, high-purity, sodium molybdate, and industrial sodium. It also provides molybdenum metal products comprising molybdenum stirrers, irregularly shaped, MAL high-, welding molybdenum, drilling molybdenum, molybdenum target, and large molybdenum; and sulfuric acid, iron concentrates, and sulfur concentrates.
